description: This Java class defines a custom view for an on-screen keyboard in an Android application, handling rendering, touch events, gesture detection, extension keyboard management, and watermark display.

classes.name: AnyKeyboardView
classes.description: A custom Android view for rendering and managing an on-screen keyboard with gesture detection, extension handling, and watermark display.

methods.name: setBottomOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the bottom offset of the keyboard view, affecting padding and layout.

methods.name: setPadding
methods.description: Overrides default padding to ensure minimum bottom offset is maintained.

methods.name: setKeyboardTheme
methods.description: Applies a new theme to the keyboard, updating related visual parameters and gesture helper.

methods.name: dismissPopupKeyboard
methods.description: Closes any active extension or utility keyboard popups.

methods.name: openUtilityKeyboard
methods.description: Opens a utility keyboard popup, typically for additional functions.

methods.name: requestInAnimation
methods.description: Sets an animation to be played when the keyboard view appears.

methods.name: setWatermark
methods.description: Sets visual watermark drawables to be displayed on the keyboard.
